entities.label: title
entities.value: The Haunted History of Elmwood Manor
entities.question: What is the title of the work?

content_blocks.label: body_text
content_blocks.text: For centuries, Elmwood Manor has stood as a silent sentinel in the heart of Elmwood, its walls concealing tales of the past that have yet to be fully told. Local historian Dr. Eliza Myles has dedicated her life to uncovering the mysteries that lie within its ancient halls. Her latest discovery, a series of cryptic journals believed to belong to the manor’s first owner, Richard Blackwood, promises to shed new light on the dark history of Elmwood. This weekend, she invites the community to join her in exploring the manor’s hidden chambers, hoping to unravel the secrets that have haunted it for generations.
